rules.burn: Burn is a stack, with no cap. At the start of the enemy's turn it loses HP equal to its Burn, then Burn goes down by 1. Any Burn above 0: it is burning.
rules.live_numbers: A number a passive changes always shows on the card, updated as you cast: green when it goes up, red when it goes down. You get what it shows when you cast it.
rules.cards_2026_11_20: Rebuilt from zero on 2026-11-20 (the user). The backpack holds at most 5 cards (active row and backpack as in the chant game, only the backpack is capped). Every card has an upgraded form: you get it by finding the same card again in a run (twice: Upgrade 1, then Upgrade 2). A card you could upgrade wiggles and shines white wherever it is offered. Strike, Block, Eye Poke and Ki Strike were removed (2026-11-21): the starting cards are still to be chosen.
rules.marbles: Essence is now called marbles. The bag starts with 4 of each colour (Fire, Water, Wind), 12 in all (2026-11-22; was 3 of each). Every turn, 3 marbles at random from the bag (2026-11-23: no free marble of each colour on the first turn any more). Drawn marbles come back only when the bag is empty. After each normal fight: a card reward or a marble reward (3 marbles at a time), 70 / 30 pseudo-random, the first reward of a run always a card (2026-11-22; was 50/50); marbles won go into the bag for good (they change the odds of drawing that colour). Found marbles are upgraded about 70% of the time. Carvings work when a card's pattern counts their marble (2026-11-22; not when the chant is spoken), for that card: sword (that card deals 3 more damage per hit this turn, stacks), shield (it gives 3 more Shield, stacks), skull (rare: that card's damage x1.5, one a card), wing (rare: its Shield x1.5, one a card); and when counted: coin (gain 1 money), heart (heal 2), fist (gain 1 Power), ghost (gain 1 Dodge); star counts as any colour. (Spent was removed 2026-11-22.)
rules.unique_patterns: Patterns of 1 to 4 marbles (order counts) in the first list, one card each; a pattern may repeat in this version (the second list, more_cards, reuses them; two cards you own can share a pattern) (2026-11-21).
rules.upgrades: A card upgrades twice: the 2nd copy found gives Upgrade 1, the 3rd gives Upgrade 2 (2026-11-20).
rules.fusion_names: A fused spell gets a name the player types; a premade name from fusion_default_names (vague, never tied to one element) is suggested as the default and can be changed (2026-11-21).
rules.statuses: Condensed 2026-11-21 (removed from the whole chant game): Dazed, Disarm, Cauterize, Curse (the op), Echo (cast twice: Echo Draught, Echo Chamber, Echo Shell, Chant Bell, Echoed Voice, Mimic), Poison and Bleed (now Burn on you, same rule as an enemy's: lose N HP at the start of your turn, then -1), Explode, Virus, Invert (Fire/Water swap), Mimic, Confuse (merged into Blind: what comes out of the slot machine shows only ?). Stoke stays as a card effect, not a status.
rules.expose_armor: Expose N (enemy status, 2026-11-21): each damage instance it takes deals +N. It does not go down each turn. Armor N is its opposite (each instance -N); enemies can have it.
rules.upgrade_and: An upgrade written as "AND ..." adds to the card's previous form (it keeps what it had) (2026-11-21).
rules.repeatable: Repeatable N: cast it up to N times in a turn, once per separate, non-overlapping instance of its pattern in the chant.
rules.carved: Carved / carving marble = an upgraded marble (one with a symbol). Enchanted means the same; the cards say Carved.
rules.defaults_2026_11_21: Durability N: casts per fight, then broken for the fight. CD N: sleeps N turns after a cast. Power: works for the rest of the fight. Weakened: deals 50% less. Vulnerable: takes 50% more. Both go down by 1 each turn. Stun: skips its next turn, then immune to stun for 1 turn. Dodge: each stack dodges one attack, stays until used. Thorns: hurt each attacker per hit, all fight. Power: +1 damage per hit. Charge: each cast adds 1; at the number it fires and goes back to 0. Activate: casts that card's effect without its marbles, not using its Durability. Water-contained card: a W in its pattern. Infuse: a star marble into the chant. Repaint into any: chant marbles become star marbles. 'Every marble / wind in your bag / you have' counts every marble you own. Circle of Life's growth lasts the run. Bottles exist.
rules.wording: Card wording (2026-11-21): statuses capitalised (Burn, Weakened, Vulnerable, Expose, Stun, Shield, Thorns, Power, Dodge, Silence); verbs Deal / Apply / Gain / Heal / Take N damage (yourself); keywords last: Repeatable N (Repeatable alone: no limit), Durability N, Cooldown N; Power: first. Each upgrade is written out whole. Words: Charge (a card's counter), Activate (do what a card does, without its marbles or Durability), Infuse (a marble into your chant), Repaint, Carve (upgrade a marble, for good), Cleanse (all your debuffs gone), Water card (a card with Water in its pattern), Extension.
